related.title: Hayabusa2 小天體撞擊器與次表層採樣
related.titleEn: Hayabusa2 small-body impactor and subsurface sampling
related.transfer: 沿任務環境、載具、地面分析與使用者決策對照邊界。
related.transferEn: Compare boundaries across mission environment, vehicle, ground analysis, and user decision.
related.why: 兩課都要求可複查的情境比較及風險處置紀錄；請先找到證據格式的共通欄位。
related.whyEn: Both courses require a reviewable scenario comparison and risk-treatment record. First find the evidence fields they share.
related.difference: 完成「Hayabusa2 小天體撞擊器與次表層採樣」工作台並留下可重做的工程紀錄。
related.differenceEn: Complete the hayabusa2 small-body impactor and subsurface sampling bench and produce a reproducible engineering record.
practice: 各選一個名義結果，保留輸入與來源。
對照介面、失效條件與資料解析度。
把一項驗證改編到另一案例，記下不可沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Select one nominal result in each case, retaining inputs and sources.
Compare interfaces, failure conditions, and data resolution.
Transfer a verification to the other case and document assumptions that do not carry across.

courses.overview: 比較太空探索、碎片與次世代任務中兩種案例的介面與驗證方法，並轉移一個工程判斷。
courses.overviewEn: Compare interfaces and verification approaches in two space exploration, debris, and next-generation missions cases, then transfer one engineering judgment.
